_about: Footprints for the laser-cut faceplates (make_templates.py). All sizes in mm, x to the right, y down, relative to the component's centre. Every number here is a placeholder for a typical part: measure the real one and edit. 'cut' is what goes through the plate; 'front' is what shows on the face (bezel, cap, nut, cover: used for the layout and the overlap check); 'behind' is the body behind the plate (checked for collisions). A size is [w, h] for a rectangle or a single number for a circle's diameter. 'extra' (any footprint) adds shapes to cut: {"circle": d, "at": [x, y]} or {"rect": [w, h], "r": radius, "at": [x, y]}, e.g. an anti-rotation tab or mounting holes.

layer_colours.note: LightBurn makes one layer per colour: keep them distinct (its palette: 00 black, 01 blue, 02 red, 03 green, 04 yellow, 05 orange)

mounting_holes.note: M3 clearance, 5 mm from each edge, at the 4 corners; must match the frame adapter

text.note: font sizes in mm; char_width (a fraction of the size) only estimates text widths for the checks

block.note: the space between the LED, the component and its legend in a control block

guarded_toggle.part: 12 mm toggle (KN3C style) under a flip cover that mounts on its bushing

lamp_button.part: rectangular lit push button, 18 x 12 mm
lamp_button.note: the legend is on the cap

button.part: rectangular push button, 18 x 12 mm (as lamp_button, unlit)

annunciator.part: one lit window per cell (a light box behind with one LED per cell)
annunciator.note: frame: the margin of the front envelope around the cells

seg7.part: 0.36 in 7-segment modules (MAX7219 style), one window per display

matrix.part: 3 mm LEDs on a 4.5 mm grid, one hole each
matrix.note: mode 'window' cuts one window over the whole grid instead (an LED matrix module behind)

alpha.part: small character display (OLED or LCD), size from the virtual console
alpha.note: the real part is not chosen: set the window to its visible area

rotary.part: rotary selector, 3/8 in bushing, knob about 15 mm
rotary.note: position legends sit on a circle around the knob; add the anti-rotation tab hole in 'extra' when the part is known

pot.part: slide potentiometer, 30 mm travel (Bourns PTA30 style)
pot.note: the lever cap moves along the slot; add the body's mounting holes in 'extra'

buzzer.part: 12 mm piezo buzzer behind the plate, sound holes

screen.part: the screen's visible area, from the panel's screen.mm
screen.note: top: the window's top edge below the faceplate's, as in the virtual console; add the screen's mounting holes in 'extra' (relative to the window's centre)
